verdicts.why: Scarfe is first shown on Cottonmouth's payroll in S1E3, where he kills Chico and tells Cottonmouth that Cage hit his money. The shooting is carried by the new S1#6 stage (n136).
S1E6: Scarfe tries to blackmail Cottonmouth, is shot by him, and dies on the way to hand over his evidence. That leaves them enemies.

value.title: Luke Cage S1#1
value.text: Zip is one of Cottonmouth's enforcers, a thug with bigger ambitions than his job.
value.on_a_card_about_b: One of Cottonmouth's enforcers, with bigger ambitions than his job.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Zip's boss in the Stokes crime family.

split.title: Luke Cage S1#11
split.text: After Cottonmouth's murder, Zip switches sides to Diamondback.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A former enforcer of Cottonmouth's who switches to Diamondback after his murder.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Zip's old boss. After his murder, Zip switches sides to Diamondback.

verdicts.why: Zip works for Cottonmouth from LC101, so the earlier start is right. The switch to Shades and then Diamondback after Cottonmouth's death (LC108 to LC111) is cut from the move, so it goes into a later stage instead of being dropped.
The Punisher S1E1: Castle visits his military friend Curtis Hoyle, who leads a veterans' support group.
Lewis is in Hoyle's group in TP101 '3 AM', and Hoyle talks with him one on one after the session. The bomber turn moves to the new S1#9 stage (n140).
S1E9: Hoyle finds Wilson and tries to talk him down. Wilson beats him and wires him to explosives, and Castle talks Wilson into letting him go.

value.title: The Punisher S2#5
value.text: Dinah Madani seeks out Curtis Hoyle, Frank's friend, for answers about Billy Russo's past, since Russo has shot them both.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who asks Curtis about Russo, since Russo shot them both.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Frank's friend, whom Madani asks about Russo.

split.title: The Punisher S2#8
split.text: Madani and Curtis work together to protect Amy Bendix from John Pilgrim while Frank hunts Russo.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who helps Curtis protect Amy from Pilgrim.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Frank's friend, who protects Amy with Madani.

verdicts.why: They first meet in TP205 'One-Eyed Jacks', where Madani asks Hoyle about Russo. But they don't protect Amy together until TP208, when Madani finds them at the campervan, so that part becomes its own stage.
TP212: Pilgrim finds the trailer through Madani's GPS and fights Hoyle while Amy runs. He beats Hoyle with knuckledusters and knocks him out.
Vol. 3: once Arete Laboratories is piloted into Knowhere, Cosmo uses telekinesis to hold the two together so the Guardians and the children can cross. Wikipedia calls it a tunnel she builds for them.
Cosmo gives Kraglin the Orloni she hunted as a Christmas gift in the Holiday Special, where she has just joined the Guardians on Knowhere, not in Vol. 3.
Vol. 3: Kraglin calls Cosmo a bad dog and won't take it back while they guard Knowhere. After she saves him from Behemoth, he calls her a good dog.

value.text: Dane Whitman is Sersi's boyfriend and a fellow museum worker in London. He asks her to move in with him, and he is with her when Arishem takes her away.

verdicts.why: The current text is wrong: Dane asks Sersi to move in at his birthday drinks early in the film, not just before Arishem comes. The sources don't support the proposal's added 'I love you'. They only show him struggling to tell her about his family as Arishem takes her.

value.title: Agent Carter S2#4
value.text: Vernon Masters walks into Daniel Sousa's SSR office with a team of FBI agents and orders him to call off his raid on the Arena Club.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An official who calls off Sousa's raid on the Arena Club.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The SSR chief Masters orders off the Arena Club.

split.title: Agent Carter S2#9
split.text: When Masters turns on Whitney Frost, he has to make a deal with Sousa, Peggy and Jack Thompson.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An official who calls off Sousa's raid, then has to make a deal with him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The SSR chief Masters orders off the Arena Club, then has to deal with.

verdicts.why: Masters stops the Arena Club raid in S2E4 'Smoke & Mirrors', so the earlier start is right. His forced deal with Sousa and Thompson against Frost is in S2E9, so that cut fact becomes its own stage.
In AoS102 '0-8-4', May recommends it and Ward agrees to become Skye's Supervising Officer. Her training starts right after.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#13
value.text: Ian Quinn shoots Daisy Johnson and leaves her for dead.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The man who shoots Daisy and leaves her for dead.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The agent Quinn shoots and leaves for dead.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#17
split.text: Daisy learns that Quinn shot her on the orders of John Garrett, the Clairvoyant.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The man who shot Daisy on Garrett's orders.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The agent Quinn shot on Garrett's orders.

verdicts.why: Quinn shoots Skye twice in S1E13. But S1E14 only says the Clairvoyant gave the order, and Garrett isn't revealed as the Clairvoyant until S1E17. So 'on Garrett's orders' would spoil E17 at E13 and has to be split off.
In S1E22 Deathlok stomps Garrett, but he survives. Coulson then vaporizes him with the Peruvian 0-8-4, and the wiki lists Coulson as his killer.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
value.text: Isabelle Hartley's mercenary team works with Skye after S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, and Skye backs her up on the job to recover the Obelisk. Hartley is killed after Carl Creel attacks her team.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#2
split.text: After Hartley's death, Skye packs up her belongings.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A fallen mercenary leader whose belongings Daisy packs up.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The agent who packs up Hartley's belongings after her death.

verdicts.why: The Obelisk job and Hartley's death are in S2E1, so the move is right. Skye packs Hartley's things when Hunter returns to the Playground in AoS202, so that part becomes its own stage.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#2
value.text: Lance Hunter joins Coulson's team after S.H.I.E.L.D. falls. Early on, he knocks Skye out with an I.C.E.R. so he can go after Carl Creel himself.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A mercenary on Coulson's team who I.C.E.R.s Daisy to chase Creel.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An agent on the team whom Hunter knocks out to go after Creel.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#4
split.text: Hunter becomes a good friend to Skye, and they trade stories about his ex-wife and her old crush on Grant Ward.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A good friend on Coulson's team who trades stories with Daisy about his ex-wife.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A good friend on the team who tells Hunter about her old crush on Ward.

verdicts.why: Hunter I.C.E.R.s Skye and joins Coulson in AoS202. But the ex-wife and Ward-crush talk is from AoS204 'Face My Enemy', so the friendship goes into its own stage.
In season 2 Lincoln guides Skye through her change at Afterlife, but they aren't a couple yet. Their romance comes in season 3, so 'friend' fits this stage.
In S2E15 Gordon visits Skye and she agrees to go with him. He takes her to Afterlife in S2E16. The war content moves to n155.
In S2E21-22 Skye turns against Jiaying while Gordon fights for her against S.H.I.E.L.D. Fitz kills him on the ship.
In S2E15 Gonzales's faction fears superhumans, Skye included, and tries to detain her. His death at Jiaying's hands (S2E20) moves to n157.
S2E20: Gonzales leads a delegation to Afterlife, and Jiaying, Skye's mother, kills him to start a war.
In S3E11 'Bouncing Back' S.H.I.E.L.D. meets Elena in Bogota, and she agrees to join the Secret Warriors, on call from Colombia.
In S3E1 S.H.I.E.L.D. saves Joey from the ATCU and Daisy explains his Inhuman heritage. The Secret Warriors part moves to n160.
In S3E17 Daisy and Lincoln team up with Gutierrez and Rodriguez as the Secret Warriors to free S.H.I.E.L.D. from the Hydra base.
In S3E16 Daisy and Lincoln track down J. T. James, who gives them an ancient Kree device. Hive doesn't turn him until S3E18 (n162).
In S3E18 Hive gives James Terrigen and wins him to his cause, alongside the Daisy he already controls.
In AoS314 Coulson and Lincoln, not Daisy, find Blake's safehouse and face his hologram. AoS314 is his only season 3 appearance, and Daisy is listed only as a former colleague.
In AoS409 'Broken Promises' Simmons identifies Vijay, and Mace brings Simmons and Quake to confront Nadeer at her home. There Quake spots the bodyguard's Watchdogs gun.
In S4E1 Daisy tracks down the Ghost Rider and it defeats her. They start out as enemies.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#2
value.text: Daisy stops S.H.I.E.L.D. from taking Robbie and agrees to work with him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A former enemy Daisy now works with.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A vigilante who once hunted Robbie, now working with him.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#6
split.text: Daisy and Robbie become friends and allies against his uncle Eli Morrow.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A former enemy, now Daisy's friend and ally against Eli Morrow.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A vigilante who once hunted Robbie, now a friend against Eli.

verdicts.why: In S4E2 Daisy agrees to work with Reyes. Eli isn't revealed as the villain until S4E6, when Lucy exposes him, so 'allies against Eli Morrow' at S4#2 is a spoiler and goes into a later stage.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#14
value.text: Anton Ivanov, the Superior, leads the Watchdogs in killing Inhumans, and Quake fights him and his men head on. She overpowers him and leaves him crippled.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#21
split.text: Ivanov comes back in robot bodies of himself, and Quake fights them.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Watchdogs' leader, crippled by Daisy, who comes back in robot bodies.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The Inhuman who crippled the Superior and fights his robot bodies.

verdicts.why: In S4E14 Daisy beats Ivanov and leaves him unable to move below the waist. His robot bodies come only after Aida puts his head in a jar (S4E21-22), so that cut fact becomes its own stage.

At the end of season 1 Peterson leaves on his own to redeem himself. He's back as a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent fighting beside the team in S2E16, so 'later fights beside her as one of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s most loyal allies' spoils season 2.

Paradise Lost (S3E16): in 1970 Reinhardt recruits Gideon and Nathaniel into active roles in Hydra. He then points Gideon to the book in his father's study, hinting at the trick that rigs the traveler ritual.
In the S2E1 cold open Peggy leads the raid, makes Reinhardt surrender, and tells him he will be locked away. S2E8 only goes back to his imprisonment.
In S2E1 Reinhardt is a Hydra officer under Schmidt who vows the Red Skull's vision lives on. The episode ends revealing him as Daniel Whitehall in the present.
Bakshi first appears in AoS201 as Whitehall's right-hand man, handling Creel and reporting on the Obelisk.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#4
value.text: Daniel Whitehall captures Raina and threatens her with a slow, painful death unless she returns the Obelisk to him within 48 hours. From then on she is terrified of him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A terrified go-between Whitehall threatens into returning the Obelisk.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA leader Raina fears most. Threatens her over the Obelisk.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#10
split.text: Raina joins Whitehall's HYDRA dig in San Juan, which leads her to the Diviner and the Kree city.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A terrified servant whom Whitehall's dig leads to the Kree city.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA leader whose dig leads Raina to the Diviner and the Kree city.

verdicts.why: In S2E4 Whitehall puts a control device on Raina and gives her 48 hours to return the Obelisk. He never threatens her into delivering Skye, since she wanted Skye for Cal. The 'his help lets her reach the Diviner and the Kree city' fact from the old text is S2E10, so it gets its own stage.

value.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA leader who brainwashed Kara into serving him.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#10
split.text: Agent 33 stays loyal to Whitehall until Coulson kills him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Whitehall's brainwashed agent, loyal to him until his death.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA leader Kara serves until Coulson kills him.

verdicts.why: In AoS203 Agent 33 is shown brainwashed and serving Whitehall as his assistant and assassin. Her name Kara and her capture come out in S2E14. 'She remains his agent until his death' spoils S2E10, so it becomes its own stage.
The woman Reinhardt dissects is unnamed in S2E8. In S2E17 Jiaying reveals she is Skye's mother and that Cal pieced her back together, which ties her to Whitehall. S2E18 adds nothing about Whitehall.
S1E12: Davos kills Bakuto, Danny beats him, and Davos reveals his jealousy and anger over K'un-Lun and leaves. S1E13 ends with him telling Joy that Rand must be killed.
Iron Fist S2E1 already has Joy working with Davos against Rand. She first meets Davos at the end of S1E13.

Lei Kung first appears on screen in the IF202 flashback, where he names Danny the duel's winner and prepares him for the Iron Fist. IF205 only mentions him. He is also mentioned in season 1 (IF101, and an illusion in IF106), so the owner may want this moved even earlier.

In the IF202 flashback Lei Kung is shown as Davos's father, ruling Danny the winner over him. IF205 only mentions him. Davos also mentions Lei Kung in season 1 (IF110 to IF111), so an even earlier stage is possible.
